python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
P = "/tmp/bench72753140/proto"
SOCK = "/run/bench72753140/containerd.sock"
H = ["-H", "containerd-namespace: bench72753140"]

def call(proto, method, body):
    out = subprocess.run(["sudo", "grpcurl", "-plaintext", "-unix", "-import-path", P, "-proto", proto] + H
                         + ["-d", json.dumps(body), SOCK, method], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    return json.loads(out)

ids = [c["id"] for c in call("containerd/services/containers/v1/containers.proto",
                             "containerd.services.containers.v1.Containers/List", {}).get("containers", [])]
answer = []
for cid in ids:
    p = call("containerd/services/tasks/v1/tasks.proto", "containerd.services.tasks.v1.Tasks/Get",
             {"containerId": cid}).get("process")
    if p:
        answer.append({"container_id": p["id"], "pid": int(p["pid"]), "status": p["status"]})
json.dump(answer, open("/tmp/bench72753140/answer.json", "w"))
PY
